THE FIRST & ONLY Reggio Emilia INSPIRED NURSERY SCHOOL

Sultanate of Oman | International Early Years Nursery School (Ages 6 Months – 4 Years)

BOOK A TOUR TODAY

Welcome to Shomoukh Nursery Schools

Shomoukh Early Childhood Education is an International Early Years Nursery School, inspired by the Reggio Emilia approach originated in Italy. Children are viewed as unique, capable, resilient, creative, curious, and intelligent.

ETHOS & CULTURE

Our Philosophy

We strive to create a happy environment emphasizing the social, emotional, physical, and mental development of each child. School, parent, and community partnerships play an essential role in every child's learning journey.

READ PHILOSOPHY
PURPOSE & CARE

Our Mission

To provide high-quality childcare services and promote creativity and self-confidence in a positive, friendly, and respectful learning environment, preparing children for lifelong learning.

LEARN MORE
COMMUNITY & VALUES

Vision & Values

We value excellence in caring and development for every child as an individual. We ensure high spirits of optimism, collegiality, and ongoing professional development for all educators.

EXPLORE VALUES

Core Principles at Shomoukh

Community

Believing in diversity while deeply respecting Omani values, building strong community bonds through regular events.

Giving Back & Sustainability

Supporting local community initiatives while teaching environmental awareness: Reducing, Reusing, and Recycling.

Health & Safety

Your child's health and safety is our top priority, meeting or exceeding all local and international industry guidelines.

Our Promise to Families

Childhood is a treasured time. We capture the joys of childhood, nurture each child's growth, and pave the way for success in school and life through the UK Early Years Foundation Stage (EYFS) curriculum and Reggio Emilia approach.

Reggio Emilia Approach

Student-centered, project-based education where children follow their own interests, with parents, teachers, and children as equal partners in the learning journey.

Inspired Teachers

Dedicated early childhood professionals acting as researchers alongside children, observing and documenting learning while encouraging thoughts, ideas, and actions.

Environment ("The 3rd Teacher")

Interconnected indoor and outdoor spaces offering provocations for learning, play, and discovery, dynamically modified based on projects and ongoing experiences.

Special Focus Areas: Second Language • Movement Matters • Handwriting

We Meet Kids Where They Are

Shomoukh Early Childhood Education accommodates children aged 6 months to 4 years. Operating 12 months per year following a 3-term academic year and a fun-filled summer camp.

Infants (3–11 months)

Providing your baby's brain with a strong foundation for learning and growing.

Hours: 8:30 AM – 1:30 PM
Toddlers (12–35 months)

Exploring the world around them and forming positive relationships with peers and adults.

Hours: 8:30 AM – 1:30 PM
Preschoolers (36–48 months)

Developing confidence and problem-solving skills to meet complex future challenges.

Hours: 8:30 AM – 1:30 PM
Flex-Care (6–48 months)

Pre-Care & After-Care services to meet individual working family schedules.

Extended Hours: 7:00 AM – 4:00 PM

Smart & Innovative Learning Spaces

Shomoukh Ateliers are places of research where children experiment with materials, light, and symbolic languages under the guidance of the Atelierista (artist). Click on any card below to explore!

Spaces Designed for Discovery

Shomoukh nursery school is full of life. Spaces around the school promote happiness, creativity, collaboration, and learning in the best way possible.

Piazza (Central Square)

A central open space where students gather to interact and collaborate.

Modern Playgrounds & Organic Garden

Indoor gymnasiums, sand kitchens, and outdoor gardens promoting nature connection.

Natural Light Classrooms & Library

Spacious rooms flooded with natural light, drama room, nurse's clinic, and library.
